rationale: S-0066-02 proposes applying the EPSP / IPSP / FULL protocol to the from-scratch DSGC family substrate (t0052 - t0059) to determine whether the family also has e_GABA = v_rest (explaining the binary regime) or e_GABA != v_rest (explaining a hyperpolarising-IPSP trap). The from-scratch family has been deprioritised. The EPSP / IPSP / FULL protocol has already produced the cross-bed comparison the project needs (t0065 on Bed A, t0066 on Bed B); a third application on the from-scratch substrate would not unblock any deposited-bed experiment. Rejecting as stale.
